title: Resolution urging DOE to award Civic Readiness Seal at all schools
summary: This resolution calls on the New York City Department of Education to ensure the New York State Seal of Civic Readiness is offered and awarded to eligible students at every public high school. Currently schools may voluntarily apply to award the seal, which the resolution says disadvantages students at schools that do not participate. The seal recognizes civic knowledge and engagement and can serve as an alternative graduation pathway to a fifth Regents exam.
